New Haven Bicycling Club Tuesday & Thursday Evening Rides

New Haven, CT · East Rock · Road

New Haven Bicycling Club Tuesday & Thursday Evening Rides is a road group ride in New Haven, CT. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30 pm from Wilbur Cross High School parking lot.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the New Haven Bicycling Club Tuesday & Thursday Evening Rides group ride

Twice-weekly evening rides from Wilbur Cross High School, ending at P&M Market on Orange Street for a drink on the curb. Several pace groups, including two beginner-friendly ones. Some groups drop, some don't; pick accordingly.
